x: Frank Thompson was a very welcome visitor at the A.G.M. He tells us that our old friend, Fred Rickards, who married again last year, has started another family and has a daughter.
The Harry Parkers, Frank Thompsons, Harry Hares, Dick Murphys and many more grand sportsmen, who although not perhaps first-class athletes, also served so well.

We are happy to report that Frank Thompson is now quite well again and is, in fact, attending athletic meetings. Harry Churcher once again won the Business Houses 2 Miles Track Championship, with Bob McMullen 2nd and at the same meeting young Dan Godfrey won the 100 and 200 Youths' events.
